context: The citizen returns for the screening result
purpose: Deliver the result; teach 審査/番号/事項/ご覧/承知/お答え

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 先日の審査、結果は出ましたか？
lines.en: The other day’s screening, are the results in?
lines.style: hopeful citizen returning for news, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お預かりの番号で確認します。
lines.en: I will check with the number on file.
lines.style: businesslike officer pulling up the record

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: prompt applicant presenting his slip, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 審査は通りました。残りの事項をご覧ください。
lines.en: You passed the screening. Please look at the remaining items.
lines.style: pleased officer delivering good news, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 承知しました。追加でお答えが必要ですか？
lines.en: Understood. Do you need any additional answers?
lines.style: relieved citizen checking next steps, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: いえ、こちらの事項にサインを。
lines.en: No, just sign this item here.
lines.style: efficient officer wrapping up the form

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: これで全部ですね。お答えありがとうございました。
lines.en: That is everything, then. Thank you for your answers.
lines.style: grateful citizen finishing the process, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご覧の控えをお持ち帰りください。
lines.en: Please take home the copy you see here.
lines.style: courteous officer handing over the receipt
